headline: Chiefs defense faces a tough play
what_happened: The Indianapolis team went for it on their fourth try, which is their final chance to move the ball, and gained enough yards to keep their turn going.
who: D.Jones carried the ball against G.Karlaftis and C.Jones.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it gives Indianapolis more time to try and score. It increased the other team's chances of winning by 8 percentage points.
